tools.name: search
tools.description: Full-text search across the AI tool directory and the repos/plugins catalog. Returns up to 10 matching tools and/or repos with their slugs and canonical URLs.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Retrieve the full text of a myaiguide.co document by id. The id is a canonical myaiguide.co URL or any myaiguide.co path (e.g. '/tools/claude' or 'https://myaiguide.co/about'). Returns id, title, text, and url.

tools.name: list_site_sections
tools.description: List every public section of myaiguide.co: tools, repos, blog, news, glossary, comparisons, categories, leaderboards, and the editorial/trust pages (about, disclosure, methodology, corrections, privacy, terms, etc.). Each section has a path, title, description and URL.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Fetch the readable text content of any page on myaiguide.co by its path (e.g. '/about', '/disclosure', '/methodology', '/tools/claude'). Reads editorial and trust pages and any other public page. Only paths on myaiguide.co are allowed.

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: List published AI tools, optionally filtered by category and pricing model, sorted by editor rating or recency. Paginated.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Fetch the full editorial record for one AI tool by slug: rating, pricing, pros/cons, target audience, use cases, FAQ, and the affiliate-safe /go redirect link.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all tool categories with their slugs and descriptions.

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: Fetch the editorial records for 2 to 3 tools side by side so you can compare them. Also returns the canonical /compare page URL.

tools.name: list_repos
tools.description: List published GitHub repos, Claude Code plugins, MCP servers, and AI skills with install info, stars, and descriptions. Paginated.

tools.name: get_repo
tools.description: Fetch the full record for one repo/plugin by slug.

tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Read the daily AI news roundups and weekly digests: new models, releases, features and pricing from the past days, newest first. Call it with no arguments to get the latest roundups. Each entry has a date, a summary and a link to its source.

tools.name: get_tool_changelog
tools.description: Fetch recent changelog entries for one tool by slug.

tools.name: list_glossary
tools.description: List plain-English AI glossary terms with their definitions.

tools.name: get_glossary_term
tools.description: Fetch one glossary term by slug, with its extended explanation and FAQ.

tools.name: list_blog
tools.description: List published blog posts (guides and tutorials), newest first.

tools.name: get_blog_post
tools.description: Fetch the full body of one blog post by slug.

tools.name: get_site_context
tools.description: Returns publisher identity, company registration, editorial contact, the site's affiliate-link disclosure, its canonical URL patterns, and the locations of its machine-readable files (llms.txt, /for-ai, sitemap.xml).

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch, list_site_sections, compare_tools, list_blog, get_blog_post, get_site_context · Private data: fetch, get_tool, compare_tools, get_repo, get_site_context · Public sink: get_blog_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch, list_site_sections, compare_tools, list_blog, get_blog_post, get_site_context · Private data: fetch, get_tool, compare_tools, get_repo, get_site_context · Public sink: get_blog_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
